full_prompt_en: A square high-contrast anime illustration is an extreme close-up of a fierce creature's face, rendered almost entirely in saturated red and solid black. There is no separate background; the head fills the frame and is cropped at every edge. Across the upper half, a thick mane or coarse fur rises in sharp red strokes from a broad black central parting. The upper-left corner is consumed by black shadow and a few red streaks, while the upper-right corner remains packed with upward and outward marks. Two round eyes dominate the middle of the image. The left eye is larger and sits high near the left edge, with a glowing flat red interior and a tiny black vertical pupil. The right eye sits lower and closer to the right edge, similarly red but slightly narrower. Dense black rings and angled strokes around both eyes make the gaze severe and unblinking. Between them, a narrow dark bridge descends into a rough red muzzle or nose shape near the bottom center. Short radiating marks follow the fur direction around the cheeks, brow, and nose, creating a bristling sense of motion within an otherwise fixed stare. At the lower left, a dark curved opening or deep fold cuts through the red texture; the lower right ends in a jagged black-and-red edge. The red is largely one intense tone, with subtle deeper crimson where strokes layer together. Illumination behaves graphically rather than naturally: the eyes and fur are red against black recesses, with no soft cast shadow or external light source visible. There is no readable text. The overall composition is claustrophobic and confrontational, using only glaring eyes, directional hatching, and extreme cropping to deliver menace.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形高反差动漫插画是凶猛生物面孔的极近特写，几乎完全由饱和红色与实黑构成。没有独立背景；头部填满画幅，并在四边被裁切。上半部浓厚的鬃毛或粗硬毛发从中央宽阔黑色分缝向外升起，化为锐利红色笔痕。左上角被黑影与少量红线吞没，右上角则塞满向上和向外的笔痕。两只圆眼占据画面中部。左眼较大，位置靠左且偏高，内部平坦地发亮红色，中央有细小黑色竖瞳。右眼位置较低、更靠右边，同样是红色，但略窄。两只眼周围密集黑圈和斜向笔痕使目光严厉而不眨。两眼之间一道狭窄暗色鼻梁下行，接到下部中央粗涩的红色口鼻或鼻部形状。短促放射笔痕沿脸颊、眉弓与鼻部的毛发方向延伸，让固定的凝视内部充满竖起般的动势。左下方一道深色弯曲开口或深褶切过红色肌理；右下则以锯齿状黑红边缘结束。红色大体保持一种强烈色调，笔触叠加处有稍深的绯红。照明依图形规律而非自然规律运作：眼睛与毛发在黑色凹处前呈红色，看不到柔和投影或外部光源。没有可读文字。整体构图逼仄而富挑衅感，仅靠逼视双眼、方向性排线和极端裁切传递威胁。
style_prompt_en: The anime graphic treatment strips color down to saturated scarlet, deeper crimson, and near-solid black. Dense directional hatching builds tactile surfaces from many short tapered marks, while unbroken black gaps create abrupt negative shapes. Flat bright accents remain sharply bounded inside darker rings, generating an intense focal pull. Forms are cropped aggressively so texture and gaze-like geometry press against every side of the frame. Stroke direction changes around bends and ridges, suggesting volume without soft grayscale modeling. Light is symbolic and poster-like: vivid red areas confront black recesses instead of following a realistic source. The composition relies on asymmetry within a strong central pressure, with one larger bright accent countered by a smaller one. A rough, bristling surface balances the simplicity of the palette. The overall effect is raw, urgent, and confrontational, with mark density and red-black opposition carrying nearly all expressive force.
style_prompt_zh: 这种动漫图形处理把颜色缩减为饱和猩红、较深绯红和近乎实心的黑色。密集方向性排线由许多短而渐尖的笔痕建立可触表面，不间断黑色空隙则形成突然出现的负形。平坦明亮的重音被深色环形边界锐利包住，制造强烈焦点吸引。形体被大胆裁切，肌理与类似凝视的几何形状向画幅各边压来。笔触方向沿转折和隆起而变化，无需柔和灰阶塑形也暗示体积。光具有象征性和海报感：鲜红区域面对黑色凹处，并不遵循写实光源。构图在强烈中央压力内部保持不对称，一个较大的明亮重音与一个较小的重音相平衡。粗硬竖起的表面平衡极简配色。整体效果原始、急迫且有逼迫感，笔痕密度与红黑对立承载几乎全部表现力量。
theme_en: An extreme close-up of a fierce red-and-black creature's face
theme_zh: 凶猛生物面孔的红黑极近特写
name: Devilman Crybaby
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
